import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns

def task_func(goals, penalties):
    goals_list = list(goals)
    penalties_list = list(penalties)

    if len(goals_list) != len(penalties_list):
        raise ValueError("goals and penalties must have the same length")

    teams = [f"Team {i + 1}" for i in range(len(goals_list))]
    df = pd.DataFrame({
        "Team": teams,
        "Goals": goals_list,
        "Penalties": penalties_list
    })

    plot = sns.pairplot(df, vars=["Goals", "Penalties"], hue="Team", diag_kind="hist")
    return df, plot
